gate.payto_binding: settlement evidence is joined to an origin ONLY by its advertised Base payTo (baseNetworkPayTo / payToByNetwork); shared-wallet evidence counts for an origin only when the origin's own 402 names that wallet (evidence_payto_mismatch / evidence_payto_unverified otherwise).
gate.level: route-level dispatch on Base; seller-level settled/payer basis feeds every route of the origin

reasons.settlement_required: Base pays only sellers above the settlement floor from enough distinct payers
reasons.no_supported_route: no advertised chain this host holds a spending wallet for
reasons.settlement_checked_at_pay_time: Solana/etc. proof read at pay time
reasons.usdc_domain_mismatch: Base USDC EIP-712 domain name is not the token's own
reasons.gateway_rail_unsupported: Circle Gateway batched rail not speakable by stock signer
reasons.delivery_failing: last real paid call did not deliver

gate.note: minSettled=50 and minPayers=3 are the DEFAULT parameters of meetsRouterGate({settled, payers, minSettled, minPayers}) and evidencePayToVerdict({..., minSettled=50, minPayers=3}); confirmed by test fixture asserting basis.minSettled === 50 and that 500 settlements from 1 payer still fails ('one wallet can manufacture a count').

genesis_current.note: All 13 settlements are founder-controlled: 12 self-tests (0x7f2db2…) + 1 founder E2E self-payment (0xc6f86e… = the treasury/payTo itself, reclassified FOUNDER_SELF_TEST). None are independent buyers.

gap.note: Mechanically the router would count 13 settlements / 2 payers (below the 50/3 floor). For legitimate market validation the true independent counts are 0/0, so the real gap is 50 independent settlements from >=3 distinct independent payers. Must not be fabricated.
